label: Search research notes
description: Find user-authored durable notes and paper summaries by text, kind, or tags. Use this when prior workspace knowledge may answer or inform the request. Notes are secondary, potentially stale evidence: distinguish them from source-backed paper or web content and read a selected note before relying on details.

parameter_descriptions.query: Text to search, or null when filtering only by kinds or tags.
parameter_descriptions.kinds: Workspace document kinds to include; use an empty list for all kinds.
parameter_descriptions.tags: Tags that should constrain results; use an empty list for no tag filter.
parameter_descriptions.limit: Maximum number of compact matches, from 1 to 50.
